_readme: THE SHARED DEFINITIONS (DECISIONS.md, W4, 7 October 2026). One file; each page renders a
collapsed "Words on this page" block (PV.wordsOnPage in _shared/picviz.js) listing only the
terms its claims.json declares under glossary.terms, in that order, with any page-specific
sentence it adds under glossary.notes. Each entry: term (the word as a reader meets it),
short (one plain definition, written as a sentence that opens with or names the term, so it
reads the same in the block and quoted alone), long (optional, a second sentence).
A page that declares a term missing here fails verify_consistency.py [glossary]; a declared
term the page never prints, or a block that is missing or differs from this file, fails
tools/disclosure.mjs. A figure drawn from data belongs in a page's notes, where it is bound
to that page's claims, never in a shared definition.

terms.short: QCEW is the Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages, the federal count of jobs covered by unemployment insurance.
NAICS 326 is the industry code for plastics and rubber products manufacturing.
Withheld (suppressed is the bureau’s own word for it): BLS holds a figure back when so few employers sit behind it that printing it would identify one of them.
terms.long: The jobs in a withheld cell are real; the number is not disclosed, which is not the same as zero.

terms.short: A cell is one figure, for one area in one year in one industry.
An establishment is one physical site, not one company.
A metro area is the federal statistical region built out of whole counties around a city.
Concentration asks how much of the local job base an industry fills next to how much it fills nationally.
terms.long: Above 1.0× is more than the country, below 1.0× is less.

terms.short: Private ownership counts private employers only, leaving out federal, state and local government jobs.
Annual averages are the twelve monthly counts averaged.
PIC-12 is the Polymer Industry Cluster’s twelve Northeast Ohio counties: Ashtabula, Cuyahoga, Geauga, Lake, Lorain, Mahoning, Medina, Portage, Stark, Summit, Trumbull and Wayne.
NAICS 325 is the industry code for chemical manufacturing, which includes resin (3252) and paint and coatings (3255).
